environment: Headless Playwright browsers on the current host; mobile profiles emulate viewport and touch, not real phone hardware.
method: Unmodified requestAnimationFrame cadence; no fake timers, forced refresh flags, or disabled frame limits. Cold open includes WASM initialization. Scrolling uses actual document viewport and visible-page rendering. Ink uses 120 real pointer moves. CPU values measure handler work, not pen-to-photon latency.
